observation.command: cd /opt/downloads && tar -xf ruby-3.1.4.tar.gz && cd ruby-3.1.4 && ./configure --prefix=/usr/local/ruby --with-ssl --disable-install-doc > /tmp/ruby_configure.log 2>&1 && make -j8 > /tmp/ruby_make.log 2>&1 && make install > /tmp/ruby_install.log 2>&1 && echo RUBY_BUILD_OK && /usr/local/ruby/bin/ruby --version
